name: CIPHERLEAKs
impact: Side-channel inferring secret register values from VMSA in SEV-SNP
mitigation: Software countermeasures are fragile and bypassable (APIC variant); hardware solutions required in future SEV
boundary_statement: CIPHERLEAKs (CVE-2021-46744) infers secret register values from the VM Save Area in AMD SEV-SNP.

AMD-SEV-SNP.evidence: Site/paper: infers secret register values from the VM Save Area (VMSA) in AMD SEV-SNP.
